notes: Demo mode: synthetic findings only (no live network queries).

findings.title: CT: brand-like names outside northwind-bakery.test
findings.why_it_matters: Certificates for hostnames containing your brand but not under your domain can indicate lookalike sites. Many hits are false positives — review carefully.
findings.trigger: CT logged brand-like certificate names outside the monitored domain
findings.what_would_change: Recent registration with a currently valid certificate raises urgency, while a brand-mimicking login page would strengthen confidence. Unrelated use of a shared word would lower concern.
findings.next_action: Check which sample names resolve and compare their infrastructure.

findings.title: Lookalike resolves: secure-northwind-bakery.test
findings.why_it_matters: A publicly resolving lookalike can be used for phishing, brand impersonation, or confusion. Compare public infrastructure and certificate use.
findings.trigger: Brand-keyword hostname with a login or support cue resolves in public DNS · shared uncommon nameserver ns1.brand-dns.test · certificate names account-verify.secure-northwind-bakery.test, login.secure-northwind-bakery.test · recent RDAP registration and a currently valid certificate
findings.what_would_change: A live page mimicking the brand would strengthen confidence. A verified defensive registration, shared DNS service, or inactive login names would lower concern.
findings.next_action: Verify which listed shared nameservers and certificate hostnames are in use.

findings.title: CT: notable hostnames in certificates
findings.why_it_matters: Wildcards and login/admin-style names in CT can expand your attack surface inventory.
findings.trigger: CT logged wildcard or login, admin, or staging-style hostnames on the monitored domain
findings.what_would_change: Unexpected names still in use would raise priority. Known or retired names would lower it.
findings.next_action: Confirm which hostnames are expected and still in use.

findings.title: Lookalike resolves: nrthwind-bakery.test
findings.detail: Variant: nrthwind-bakery.test. Reason: Missing character typosquat. Addresses: 203.0.113.20 (synthetic)
findings.why_it_matters: A publicly resolving lookalike can be used for phishing, brand impersonation, or confusion. Compare public infrastructure and certificate use.
findings.trigger: Missing character typosquat resolves in public DNS · parking nameservers · shared CDN IP 203.0.113.20 · shared registrar Example Registrar Ltd (fictional)
findings.what_would_change: An uncommon infrastructure overlap or brand-mimicking content would raise concern. Shared hosting, CDN, or registrar links offer no evidence of affiliation. Confirmed parking would lower concern.
findings.next_action: Log and monitor the variant, escalating only if independent evidence emerges.

findings.title: CT: 12 cert(s) for northwind-bakery.test
findings.detail: Sample names: northwind-bakery.test, www.northwind-bakery.test, api.northwind-bakery.test, staging.northwind-bakery.test
findings.why_it_matters: CT logs show which hostnames have had publicly logged TLS certificates — useful for discovering forgotten subdomains.
findings.trigger: CT returned certificate entries for the monitored domain
findings.what_would_change: Unexpected names or issuers would raise priority. Issuance that matches inventory would keep priority low.
findings.next_action: Compare the certificate sample with the expected inventory.

findings.title: apex resolves (northwind-bakery.test)
findings.why_it_matters: Baseline confirmation that the monitored domain is live in public DNS.
findings.trigger: The monitored hostname returned a public DNS address or alias
findings.what_would_change: An unexpected address or alias would raise priority. A match to the expected DNS records would keep priority low.
findings.next_action: Compare the answer with the expected DNS records.

findings.trigger: The monitored hostname returned a public DNS address or alias
findings.what_would_change: An unexpected address or alias would raise priority. A match to the expected DNS records would keep priority low.

findings.title: RDAP registration for northwind-bakery.test
findings.detail: Registered: 1995-08-14T04:00:00Z; Status: client delete prohibited; NS: ns1.dns-provider.test, ns2.dns-provider.test (synthetic)
findings.why_it_matters: Public registration metadata helps confirm registrar, expiry, and nameservers.
findings.trigger: Public registration records were returned for the monitored domain
findings.what_would_change: Unexpected registrar or nameserver changes would raise priority. Records matching the expected registration would keep priority low.
findings.next_action: Compare the registration details with the domain inventory.

disclaimer: Personal project demo using public DNS, Certificate Transparency (crt.sh), and RDAP/WHOIS only. Not enterprise threat intelligence. Expect false positives.
